verdict.rationale: The only documented natural-language interface is a docs MCP server that lets AI tools look up Medusa documentation. That is adjacent, since it does not operate the store. Pricing-page labels like "Cloud Development Agent" and "Medusa MCP and Cloud CLI", and the tagline "Guardrails for agents to build customizations", are bare mentions. None of them documents natural-language commands for operating the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
